preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call enableBlacklist() function with any target contract address to blacklist it. This will prevent the blacklisted contract from sending or receiving tokens, effectively stopping its transactions. The exploit demonstrates the owner's excessive control over contract functionality.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The CoinToken contract has an owner-only function enableBlacklist() that can blacklist any address. Once blacklisted, addresses cannot send or receive tokens. This demonstrates excessive owner privilege where the owner can arbitrarily restrict any address from using the token.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call enableBlacklist() to blacklist the attacker's address, then verify the blacklist status.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Find the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call enableBlacklist(attacker) on the target contract. 4. Verify that isBlacklisted(attacker) returns true.
